title: Query budget runtime bound
statement: For all $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$, the exact sparse spectrum query budget, viewed as a real number, is at most $1+2^{171}\bigl(12(n+1)(2^k+1)^2\bigr)^{100}$.
caveat: The query budget is defined through several auxiliary sampling and learning constructions, whose full mathematical descriptions are not supplied in the payload.
